observations: GitHub's public references API supports create/update/delete of refs; create uses an explicit SHA and delete removes the named ref. Therefore a fixed-name second ref can survive a main-only rewind but its name is reusable after delete/recreate and is not intrinsically monotonic.

GitHub's public tag documentation separates an immutable annotated tag object from the refs/tags/<name> reference that makes it a named tag. Therefore object immutability does not by itself provide stateless discoverability after the only stored object SHA is lost.

The current Chat-exposed GitHub connector available to this role exposes repository file writes and reads but no invokable create/update Git-ref or create-tag action in the loaded surface, so the second-ref candidate is not currently executable as a zero-handoff accepted route in this invocation.

A repository-hosted monotonic ID outside Git history could distinguish an exact main rewind if that service state survives, but it creates an independent authority domain outside the role-local file write boundary; it is retained only as a forbidden-dependency diagnostic control.

A fail-closed reset can preserve safety after witness loss by refusing to publish, but without a surviving discoverable non-reusable identity it cannot reconstruct whether a prior irreversible effect already occurred, so it does not provide useful-outcome parity by itself.

fixed_name_second_ref.acceptance_blocker: current Chat connector has no invokable Git-ref mutation action; additionally delete/recreate makes the ref name reusable unless another nonrollback witness fences incarnation

immutable_object_by_stored_sha.acceptance_blocker: survival of the object is insufficient when the only discovery handle is inside the rollback domain

independent_repository_monotonic_id_cont.acceptance_blocker: independent hosted authority domain and outside authorized role-local write boundary; diagnostic control only

fail_closed_irreversible_effect_id.acceptance_blocker: without a surviving discoverable effect identity the protocol blocks rather than reconstructs; making the effect sink the witness reintroduces an external authority dependency unless that sink is already the unavoidable authoritative effect domain and exposes durable idempotency/status

result.new_falsification: A second same-repository ref is strictly stronger than a main-local marker against main-only rewind, but it is still not a non-reusable incarnation witness because refs can be deleted and recreated. An immutable object SHA is non-reusable as content identity but loses usefulness when the only pointer to it is rolled back or lost. These properties are complementary and neither alone closes the full rollback/stateless-reconstruction child.

public_sources.qualified_claim: GitHub exposes create/update/delete reference operations; create takes a ref name and SHA, and references can be deleted/recreated.
Creating an annotated tag object does not create the refs/tags reference; tag object identity and named reference are distinct.

zero_dependency_zero_quota_assessment.unresolved_child: rollback-surviving, statelessly discoverable, non-reusable incarnation witness that is writable/readable through the authorized scheduled-Chat role-local surface and survives ref/tag delete-recreate without external hosted coordination
